SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. D 2257
S.1. Special Branch Station 7
REPORT
Date February 14, 19 38

Subject (in full) J.D. Blackwood.

Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by C. Crawford

In accordance with the instructions of the D.C.
(Special Branch), it has been ascertained from Captain
Manlove, Staff Captain, S.V.C. that J.D. Blackwood was last
on parade not later than April 1936.

Since forwarding the report dated February 8, 1938,
no further information has been obtained concerning the
present movements of J.D. Blackwood.

J.M. Brown.
D.S.

S.I. Special Branch
REPORT
Date February 8, 19 38.

Subject (in full) J.D. Blackwood.

Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by C. Crawford

Inquiries by D.S. Larby in the International
Settlement and the French Concession have failed to establish
that J.D. Blackwood has been resident in Shanghai for the
past year.

According to information from a Japanese source,
Blackwood is said to be now residing in Kobe, but the nature
of his employment is not known.

With regard to the whereabouts of the missing S.V.C.
equipment, the general opinion among Blackwood's former
associates is that it was pawned many months ago.

报告
日期 1938年2月8日。

事由（全称） J.D. Blackwood。

由 D.S. McKeown 编制，经 C. Crawford 转呈

侦探警长 Larby 在公共租界及法租界进行的查询，未能证实 J.D. Blackwood 在过去一年内居住于上海。

据一日本方面消息来源称，Blackwood 现居神户，但其受雇性质不详。

关于失踪的上海义勇队（S.V.C.）装备的下落，Blackwood 的前同事普遍认为，这些装备已于数月前被典当。

（批注：与参谋上尉联系。他何时在义勇队服役？Jhy 2月8日 致副巡官助理）

From
HEADQUARTERS.
SHANGHAI VOLUNTEER CORPS.
Shanghai, 13th January, 193 8.

Ref: 111/64.
To Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Subject: BLACKWOOD J.D. - PRIVATE ADDRESS.

I would be very grateful if you could furnish me
with the private address of the abovementioned, who was
a member of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps.
He was until recently with Blackwood, Cares & Co.,
at 171 Museum Road, but has dissolved partnership with
Mr. Care..
This information is required in order that his
firearms and kit may be collected.
Thanking you for any assistance you may be able to
give me.

W. Macmor.
Captain,
Staff Officer,
Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

TWO

总部。
上海义勇队。
上海，1938年1月13日。

参考号：111/64。
致：上海公共租界工部局警务处警务总监。

事由：BLACKWOOD J.D. - 私人住址。

如蒙提供上述人士之私人住址，本人将不胜感激。该人系上海义勇队队员。
他此前一直在博物馆路171号的 Blackwood, Cares & Co. 公司任职，但已与 Care 先生解除合伙关系。
索取此信息旨在收缴其枪械及装备。
感谢您提供任何可能的协助。

W. Macmor.
上尉，
参谋军官，
上海义勇队。
